systematic review ChatGPT higher education research outcomes

search_strategy: Focus on 2022 to present, since ChatGPT-era generative AI is the relevant intervention, and prefer empirical studies (experiments, quasi-experiments, surveys, interviews, mixed methods) plus systematic reviews on graduate or doctoral students. Exclude work limited to undergraduates or K-12, purely technical LLM benchmarks with no human users, and opinion pieces without data unless they supply policy context. Expect rq6 and the causal evidence on research quality in rq2 to be the thinnest, since most studies rely on self-reports rather than objective output measures.}
